newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures seen supported by tankan.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures seen supported by tankan.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed above an important resistance level on Wednesday, gaining after a better-than-expected Bank of Japan "tankan" survey of corporate sentiment.
Dealers said the close -- 390 points higher at 20,765 points -- was positive and indicated the market could firm further later in the week.
"It is telling us it could go higher -- possibly up towards 21,000 points," said one dealer who follows technical chart analysis. "I'm looking at a new target at just under 21,000."

The tankan report showed confidence high among some of Japan's industrial sectors. Its key diffusion index for major manufacturers was plus seven, up from plus two in March and compared with economists' forecasts of minus four to plus four.
Many dealers had expected a bearish report.
One technical analyst said he now expected the market to consolidate, moving sideways to slightly higher in the next few days. He said was little immediate risk of a severe fall.
"The downward side is limited. I think 20,550 points should now be a good support," he said.
Dealers said market sentiment was buoyant but was still held in check by worries over inflationary pressures, which some dealers thought might eventually lead to higher interest rates.
